name: Tennessee 4-H Roundup and All Star Conference
what_you_do: High school 4-H members compete in project judging. They go to workshops and a career fair. They do service and leadership tasks. They also vote in 4-H state council elections.
who_can_apply: High school 4-H members who are project finalists, state winners or All Stars. You sign up through a county Extension office.
pay_detail: $75 for state finalists. $325 for All Stars attending as non-finalists. State Council members and volunteer leaders attend on scholarship.
deadline_text: Registration day is Monday, July 19, 2027. Roundup ends Thursday evening, July 22, 2027.
how_to_apply: Register through your county Extension office. Students and a parent or guardian must sign Form 600A before attending.
notes: Level I is 9th and 10th grade. Level II is 11th and 12th grade. Council officer candidates must already be in the Tennessee 4-H Honor Club.
